mapper.sql: id, user_id, identity_type, issuer, identifier, normalized_identifier, status, verified_at, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at, provider_profile AS provider_profile_json
mapper.update: UPDATE user_identity AS identity SET provider_profile = identity.provider_profile || jsonb_build_object( 'nickname', CAST(#{nickname} AS TEXT), 'nicknameSyncedAt', CAST(#{syncedAt} AS TEXT)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE identity.identity_type = 'WECHAT' AND identity.issuer = #{issuer} AND identity.normalized_identifier = #{subject} AND identity.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_account AS account WHERE account.id = identity.user_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE')
